user.title: Add mmRadar device
user.description: Enter the device's LAN address and pairing token. You can find the token on the device screen or in the mmRadar app settings.

pair.title: Pair with mmRadar
pair.description: Found device {device_id}. Enter its pairing token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair
reauth_confirm.description: The device's pairing token is no longer valid. Enter the new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check that it is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: That pairing token is not correct.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This device has already been added.
abort.no_device_id: The device did not advertise a device_id, so it cannot be identified.

calibrate_co2.name: Calibrate CO2
calibrate_co2.description: Force a recalibration of the SCD41 in fresh outdoor air.

reference_ppm.name: Reference concentration
reference_ppm.description: Fresh outdoor air is about 420 ppm.

calibrate_zone.name: Calibrate target zone
calibrate_zone.description: Read the current distance and set the zone automatically. Sit at your desk first.

identify.name: Identify
identify.description: Flash the device screen so you can tell which one it is.

set_zone.name: Set target zone
set_zone.description: Manually set the distance range that counts as being at the desk.

set_radar.name: Set radar parameters
set_radar.description: The radar module's own detection range. Different from the target zone: this decides what the module reports at all, the target zone decides what counts as being seated.

stale_entities.title: mmRadar has {count} entities whose sensors are gone

confirm.title: Delete these entities?
confirm.description:
Device {device} can no longer detect the sensors behind these entities, so they will stay unavailable:

{entities}

**Deleting also removes their history, and automations referencing them will break.**

If a sensor is merely loose or temporarily unplugged, reconnect it and reload the integration — this notice will clear itself.
